## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused, and unrelated changes are left out
- [ ] Tests are added or updated (bug fixes include a test that fails without the fix)
- [ ] Backend: `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, and `pytest` pass
- [ ] Frontend: `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] New user-facing text is added to **both** `messages/en.json` and `messages/de.json`
- [ ] No secrets, real personal data, or customer branding are included
- [ ] Docs are updated where behavior changed
